model.title: Transcription Model
model.description: Choose the model used to transcribe your scanned pages on this device.

missing.title: Model not downloaded
missing.message: Download this model to transcribe your pages. It's a one-time download.

partial.title: Download incomplete
partial.message: A previous download didn't finish. Resume to continue where it left off.

unverified.title: Verification incomplete
unverified.message: All files are downloaded, but integrity verification didn't finish.

unintegrated.title: Setup incomplete
unintegrated.message: Model files are verified, but runtime integration didn't finish.

failed.title: Model setup failed
failed.message: Something went wrong while preparing this model. Try again.

errors.notEnoughStorage: Not enough storage space. You need at least {size: String} free to download this model.
errors.noConnection: No internet connection. Connect and try again.
errors.serverUnreachable: Couldn't reach the download server. Please try again later.
errors.corrupted: The downloaded files are damaged. Downloading them again.
errors.downloadFailed: The download failed. Check your connection and try again.
errors.resumeFailed: Couldn't resume the download. Starting over from the beginning.

discard.title: Discard model files
discard.message: Delete all downloaded and partial files for {name: String}?

required.title: Download needed
required.message: This model needs a one-time download before you can transcribe pages. You can leave the app while it downloads. Progress will show in a notification.

wifiOnly.label: Use Wi-Fi for large downloads
wifiOnly.description: Large downloads wait for Wi-Fi instead of using mobile data.
